# GitHub Copilot Episodic Memory Implementation

I'm implementing an episodic memory system for GitHub Copilot that remembers specific moments, decisions, meetings, and milestones, providing rich contextual awareness for personalized development assistance.

**Purpose**: Remembers moments - who was in that Zoom call, what was said, when decisions were made, key project milestones. Provides personalized context for development decisions.
